summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called inclisiran compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance, in patients who have had a procedure to open blocked blood vessels in their heart or legs. Duke University is sponsoring this study, which is currently Recruiting with a target enrollment of 6000 participants. The goal is to see how well the treatment prevents major heart and limb events over a period of up to about four years. This is a Phase 4 study.
